action_instruction: Reviewing the reserved-flight heading and reservation details
intent: PRIMARY: review the reserved-flight heading and reservation details; role=text | HINTS: container=top of BlazeDemo purchase page
rationale: The required heading, labels, and values are visibly confirmed on the purchase page.

action_params.condition: The reserved-flight heading is exactly "Your flight from TLV to SFO has been reserved.".
action_params.expected_value: Your flight from TLV to SFO has been reserved.
locators: internal:role=heading[name="Your flight from TLV to SFO"i]

output_value: Your flight from TLV to SFO has been reserved.

action_instruction: Reading the reservation detail field labels

action_params.condition: The reservation details labels are exactly Airline, Flight Number, Price, Arbitrary Fees and Taxes, and Total Cost.
action_params.expected_value: Airline, Flight Number, Price, Arbitrary Fees and Taxes, Total Cost

output_value: Airline, Flight Number, Price, Arbitrary Fees and Taxes, Total Cost

action_instruction: Reading the Airline value from the reservation details
intent: the Airline value in the reservation details

action_params.query: the Airline value in the reservation details

action_instruction: Reading the Flight Number value from the reservation details
intent: the Flight Number value in the reservation details

action_params.condition: The Flight Number value is UA954.
action_params.query: the Flight Number value in the reservation details

action_instruction: Reading the Price value from the reservation details
intent: the Price value in the reservation details

action_params.query: the Price value in the reservation details

assertion_tree.description: the heading is exactly "Your flight from TLV to SFO has been reserved.", the reservation details labels are exactly Airline, Flight Number, Price, Arbitrary Fees and Taxes, and Total Cost, the Airline value is United, the Flight Number value is UA954, and the Price value is 400.

sub_results.description: The reserved-flight heading is exactly "Your flight from TLV to SFO has been reserved.".
sub_results.expected: Your flight from TLV to SFO has been reserved.

variable_refs.{{reserved_flight_heading_check}}: Your flight from TLV to SFO has been reserved.

variable_refs.{{reservation_details_labels_check}}: Airline, Flight Number, Price, Arbitrary Fees and Taxes, Total Cost

assertion_tree.verification: The reserved-flight heading and reservation details section display all specified heading, labels, and values.
